title: Homestead 3 that people refuse to enter

tellings.quote: which is the oldest structure on the property. And it's a structure that some people refuse to enter.

plain: On Skinwalker Ranch, a property known for reports of strange events, there is an old building called Homestead 3 that some people will not walk into. Brandon Fugal, the businessman who owns the ranch, says it is "the oldest structure on the property" and that some visitors refuse to enter it, and he names a woman called Kristen and the musician Trent Reznor in connection with the place. He tells it from his own time owning the ranch, from about 2016 on, as a sign that the building gives people a feeling they cannot shake.
